github.name: GitHub
github.summary: Reads one repository: its files, code search, and its issues and pull requests.
examples: What does config/agents.json say about the textql agent?
Which open issues mention the scheduler?
Where is the Cliq read budget defined?

fields.label: Repository
fields.help: The one repository this agent reads.

fields.label: Access token
fields.help: Needed for private repositories and for higher rate limits.

gdocs.name: Google Docs
gdocs.summary: Searches and reads the Google Docs shared with your service account, at any folder depth.
examples: Find the onboarding spec and summarise it
Which docs mention the pricing change?
What do the latest meeting notes say about next steps?

fields.label: Service account key
fields.help: The JSON key file of a Google service account. Share the folders you want read with that account's email address.

knowledge.name: Knowledge base
knowledge.summary: Answers from captured Slack threads and the documents they link to, with every quotation checked against its source.
examples: What did we agree with the client about tracking?
Who decided to move the launch, and why?
What has been corrected about the GTM container?

connection.note: Runs on this server. Nothing to connect.

jira.name: Jira
jira.summary: Searches and reads Jira issues across every project the account can see, including status, assignee and comments.
examples: What's the status of the checkout bug?
Which issues were assigned to me this week?
List the open issues in the DATA project

fields.label: Jira site
fields.patternHelp: Just the site name, e.g. yourcompany.atlassian.net (no https://)

fields.label: API token
fields.help: Create one at id.atlassian.com, under Security, API tokens.

slack.name: Slack
slack.summary: Searches and reads conversations in the channels the bot has been invited to.
examples: What was decided in #launch about the date?
Summarise yesterday's thread about the outage
Which channels can you read?

fields.label: Bot token
fields.patternHelp: A bot token starts with xoxb-

fields.label: User token
fields.patternHelp: A user token starts with xoxp-
fields.help: Needed for search, which Slack only allows with a user token.

cliq.name: Zoho Cliq
cliq.summary: Searches and reads Zoho Cliq channels and the threads inside them.
examples: What did the team discuss in the ops channel today?
Find the thread about the invoice delay
Which Cliq channels can you see?

fields.label: Zoho data centre
fields.help: Where your Zoho account lives: the end of your Zoho address, e.g. zoho.com or zoho.eu.

workdrive.name: Zoho WorkDrive
workdrive.summary: Lists WorkDrive folders and files, who they're shared with, and reads the text inside documents.
examples: Which SOP covers the spade crimp size?
Who can access the Projects folder?
List the files in the Live folder

fields.label: WorkDrive MCP server URL
fields.help: From your Zoho MCP console. It contains a secret, so treat it like a password.

textql.name: TextQL
textql.summary: Answers questions about the numbers in your connected databases through TextQL's analyst, Ana, including charts.
examples: Which 5 start stations had the most trips?
Chart the number of trips per month
What was total revenue last quarter?

fields.label: API key
fields.help: A service account key from TextQL, under Settings, API Keys & Access.

fields.label: Data connections
fields.patternHelp: Connection numbers from TextQL, separated by commas
fields.help: Without at least one, Ana has no data to query.
